note: Page holds two different lists. CONVENTIONS: (a) role_raw is the printed cell text with the name excised; where a grade/section code precedes the name and a role word follows it, the two printed fragments are joined with ' - ' (e.g. printed '2B - Julie Hudson - Teacher' -> role_raw '2B - Teacher'). (c) Trailing colons on the line 5-10 labels are kept as printed.
